gloss: Used as a tag question, to emphasise what goes before or to request that the listener express an opinion about what has been said.
In isolation, a request for repetition or clarification of what has just been said.
In isolation, expressing surprise or confusion.
An interjection used to ascertain the continued attention of someone addressed by the speaker.
A tick-borne disease caused by infection with bacteria of the genus Ehrlichia.
Any of a group of inherited connective tissue disorders caused by a defect in the synthesis of collagen, and resulting in abnormally elastic skin, joints, muscles, etc.
